evals.prompt: Create an agent suite for Next.js 15 Server Actions with strict validation using Zod and CSRF protection.
evals.expected_output: Analyzes requirements and generates a Domain Skill for Next.js Server Actions plus an Antigravity Rule enforcing CSRF protection and input validation.
assertions: Outputs === AGENT SUITE ANALYSIS & DISCOVERY === block
Scaffolds or updates a modular Skill under frameworks/nextjs/skills/
Scaffolds or updates an Antigravity Rule under frameworks/nextjs/rules/
Does NOT generate legacy standalone .md workflows
Runs verify_suite.py on the resulting suite directory

evals.prompt: Create an automated deployment pipeline for deploying NestJS microservices to AWS ECS with Fargate.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes procedural task and generates a Procedural Execution Skill with step-by-step checklist, rollback instructions, and pre-flight scripts.
assertions: Classifies task as Archetype B (Procedural Execution Skill)
Generates SKILL.md with sequential checklist (- [ ] Step...)
Includes scripts/ for pre-flight deployment health check
